notes.title: Nominate Death of a Wish for the Steam Awards!
notes.content:
[b]Death of a Wish[/b] is discounted 25% for the [b]Steam Autumn Sale[/b]! This is a great chance to get the game at a discount. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44191615/729ad1c9055e6383bc5479fa515c3e84caa6278e.png[/img]

Concurrent to the [b]Steam Autumn Sale[/b] are nominations for [url=https://store.steampowered.com/steamawards/nominations?snr=1_5_9_][b]The Steam Awards[/b][/url]! [list]
[*][b]Labor of Love[/b] - This game has been out for a while. The team is well past the debut of their creative baby, but being the good parents they are, these devs continue to nurture and support their creation. This game, to this day, is still getting new content after all these years.
[*][b]Outstanding Visual Style[/b] - Visual style doesn't aspire to real-world graphical fidelity (though a noble goal in itself)… it describes a distinctive look and feel that suffuses an entire game.
[*][b]Outstanding Story-rich Game[/b] - Some days, only a narrative-heavy game will hit the spot, and this one packs a wallop. It's as gripping as any soap opera, and as well-tuned as a prestige-TV screenplay. Bravissimo -- for making us feel things!
[/list]

You can submit your nominations [url=https://store.steampowered.com/steamawards/nominations?snr=1_5_9_]here[/url]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44191615/086bbd45b5f2097468e7689dc4c0d57cbb1f52ab.png[/img]

notes.title: The Martyr Mode Update is here!
notes.content:
The [b]Martyr Update[/b] for [b]Death of a Wish[/b] is here! This colossal new update adds a massive new challenge mode that adds even greater replayability and challenge to this subversive action-RPG! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44191615/4553a202b04774279292f9648e9f1d87439e17ed.png[/img]

To celebrate, we are [b]discounting the game to its lowest-ever price[/b] as the [u]Steam Daily Deal for September 19th![/u] Save 25% on all editions of [b]Death of a Wish[/b]! 

There's a lot to cover in this update, so let's dive right in. 

[h2]ABOUT MARTYR MODE [/h2]
[b]Martyr Mode[/b] is our version of an ultra-challenging, endgame mode with randomization, customization, and scoreboards. In it, players build a deck of Challenge Cards in order to apply challenging new rules to their [b]Death of a Wish[/b] run in exchange for score multipliers. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44191615/8a8eb293dca65cf20562955c3a08bac6956208e1.jpg[/img]

In [b]Martyr Mode[/b], the cumulative score of each mandatory encounter is recorded and factored into your final score at the end of each run. Bonus points are rewarded for completing optional objectives and taking on Challenge Cards.

The start of each track will present players with three Challenge Cards to pick from. Challenge Cards introduce new rule modifiers that mix up combat and increase difficulty. These include rules such as:
[list]
[*] [b]Comeback[/b] - Upon recovering from a status effect, enemy attacks are 100% more powerful for 10 seconds.  
[*] [b]Break Invuln (ii)[/b] - Enemy invulnerable after recovering from Break for 4 seconds
[*] [b]Lost Grace (ii)[/b] - Reduces non-S Rank Corruption reduction by 75%.
[/list]
Each [b]Challenge Card[/b] will introduce more challenging rules, but grant greater score bonuses during a run. Challenge Cards will stack cumulatively over the course of a player’s entire run, so it is critical to make deliberate decisions about which cards to add to your deck and when. Escalating the risk can provide great rewards, but only if you can survive to complete them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44191615/f57e26436acf5f39866f969f82aa8ae209abb7f1.jpg[/img]

There are 40 challenge cards in all, and an infinite range of ways to mix and match them creatively to tune a run for a high score. How will you rise to the challenge? 

[h3]BALANCES & FIXES[/h3]
This update brings with it some balances and changes to further aid the [b]Death of a Wish[/b] combat experience, including:
[list]
[*] Reduced health of late-game bosses.
[*] Slightly easier BREAKs on tankier bosses.
[*] Reduced the penalty to health essence recovery on higher Punishment difficulties.
[*] Increased the wind-up time on most enemy gunfire attacks.
[*] Decreased the hitbox size of all enemy gunfire projectiles.
[*] [Randomizer] Decreased the prevalence of miniboss and story boss summons in True Randomizer mode.
[/list]

[h2]NEW LANGUAGES ARE COMING[/h2]
We are actively interested in localizing [b]Death of a Wish[/b] to other languages like Simplified Chinese, Spanish, and French. 

[b]If you’re interested in playing Death of a Wish in your language, please fill out the Localization Survey! We want to know what languages you would like to play in! [/b]

[h3][url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSclk0SO6XrIMoDMpANA9nik0AHgGd2A8nkRa5L3CNjHsKQhrQ/viewform?usp=sf_link]LOCALIZATION SURVEY[/url][/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2302080/Death_of_a_Wish/

notes.title: The Apocrypha Update is here!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44191615/f6e611b416ad87c936af3eb59a4d6da8f13f94e8.jpg[/img]
We are thrilled to share that Nicolo Telesca's original soundtrack for [b]Death of a Wish[/b] is out now on Steam! Relive the horror and grace of Paradiso through 16 tracks of dub atmosphere, breakcore boss rushes, and trip hop beats to dissociate and kill gods to. 

[h1]The Apocrypha Update[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44191615/bf1ca596a8b1f1b89c60f133a26828d2a380174f.png[/img]
[b]The Apocrypha Update[/b] is coming to Death of a Wish on 07/22! This major new update adds new features to the [b]Familiar Garden[/b] area. Let's break them down!

[h3]Boss Rush Mode[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44191615/baac12b763c4774c18e4d068bfeac55fc05e8aa9.gif[/img]
[b]Death of a Wish[/b] is filled with devious bosses that will pose an exciting challenge to all sorts of players. The Apocrypha Update will add a Boss Rush mode that allows you to challenge all of them in a single battery of fights with limited resources. Every boss is scaled for endgame levels, ensuring that early game bosses still pose an exciting threat. Can you survive until the end? 

[h3]Music Room[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44191615/952c8e1cff5af159b72a0874f570d4633089d716.gif[/img]
[b]The Apocrypha Update[/b] adds a new room where you can browse and play songs from Death of a Wish's dark soundtrack. Take some time to appreciate the bleak instrumentation and drones of Paradiso. 

[h3]Training Arena[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44191615/c3482340f52dbb409a913f4548a5e809b861ed94.gif[/img]
Practice combat against any enemy you have already encountered. Struggling with a specific enemy's moveset and timing? Train against it in the arena to discover its weaknesses and vulnerabilities and achieve better outcomes in combat. Your attempts at challenging late game encounters will never be the same. 

[h1]The Time Masters Festival[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44191615/07e27562df9c1bc46264710f79ea1bb352d0a2f6.png[/img]
Finally, Death of a Wish is now discounted to its lowest-ever price! Pick up this critically acclaimed nightmare at a 20% discount for the first time ever as part of the [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/44968775/sale/TimeMasters]Time Masters Festival[/url][/b]!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2302080/Death_of_a_Wish/

notes.title: The Randomizer Update is here!
notes.content:
Today is the first day of LudoNarraCon, and we are thrilled to release the first major update for [b]Death of a Wish[/b]: The Randomizer Update! 

[h2]Death of a Wish Randomizer[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44191615/63b5f89098a254fa13555aa6654efee5832dd6c4.png[/img]

The [b]Randomizer Update[/b] adds a new mode that allows players to experience the Nightmare like never before! This mode allows players to replay the entire game with randomized enemy and item placements, including randomized starting equipment. 

Take on the game in brand new ways by mastering different combat styles and managing unpredictable encounters. No two playthroughs will be the same, so it's almost like trying the game from scratch! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44191615/94afb8ba2becb8ee52b120f05aa8857311c50019.png[/img]

For those who want to crank the difficulty up even more, this update also includes a "True Randomizer" mode that makes it possible for players to encounter mini-bosses and regular bosses as regular enemies in the world. These options provide [b]Death of a Wish[/b] with new depth and replayability!

[i]The Randomizer Mode unlocks as a reward for completing the main game, but you can also unlock it and other completion rewards from a new "Unlock Completion Rewards" setting under - Options - in the main menu![/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44191615/28b2d9890ed41812834c048b41a6ec495397df33.png[/img]

[h2]macOS and Linux Support[/h2]

Alongside the Randomizer Update, we're also launching Mac and Linux versions of [b]Death of a Wish[/b] today! As of today, the game is now available on PC, Mac, Linux, and Nintendo Switch. If you have been holding out for the game to come to your platform of choice, now's a fantastic time to get it because the game is being discounted for [b]LudoNarraCon[/b]! 

[h3][b]IMPORTANT:[/b] For [b]STEAM DECK[/b] Users[/h3]
For existing Steam Deck players, if you'd like to continue using the Windows version of the game, please select [b]Manage[/b] (the gear icon) on the game in your library, then [b]Properties[/b] > [b]Compatibility[/b] > [b]Force the use of a specific Steam Play compatibility tool[/b], then [b]select a version of Proton from the dropdown[/b] (Proton Experimental works fine from my testing). The game should then update briefly and you'll be good to go!

Likewise, [b]if you'd like to use the native Linux version on Steam Deck instead[/b], follow the directions above, except instead of choosing a version of Proton from the compatibility dropdown, [b]select Steam Linux Runtime[/b] (it should be near the bottom or at the bottom of the list). After a brief update, the game will be ready to run its Linux version.

Note that [b]the save file locations for the Windows and Linux versions are different from each other[/b], so if you'd like to maintain your progress when switching platforms, you'll want to [b]copy the save data file from the first location to the other[/b]. These files can be found on your Steam Deck at the file paths below:

Windows version: [i]Home/.steam/steam/steamapps/compdata/2302080/pfx/drive_c/users/steamuser/AppData/LocalLow/melessthanthree/DeathOfAWish/savedGames.gd[/i]
Linux version: [i]Home/.config/unity3d/melessthanthree/DeathOfAWish/savedGames.gd[/i]

[h2]LudoNarraCon[/h2]

We're so excited to let you all know that [b]Death of a Wish[/b] is an official selection for this year's edition of LudoNarraCon! This digital festival hosted by indie publisher Fellow Traveler runs from May 9 - 13, kicking off at 10 AM Pacific Time on the 9th. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44191615/453e0b0942f99e53fa1cfb4ec51e799edca16457.png[/img]

During this event Colin will be showing off  the Randomizer Update in action via a livestream on May 9 at 11 AM Pacific Time.

Colin and Kevin are also hosting a panel on Meaningful Combat Design in Narrative Games during the event alongside Marina Kittaka, Sherveen Uduwana, and Lily Valeen as part of LudoNarraCon! These are the brilliant minds behind [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2393920/Angeline_Era/]Angeline Era[/url], [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1582380/Midautumn/]Midautumn[/url], and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2075160/BOSSGAME_The_Final_Boss_Is_My_Heart/]BOSSGAME[/url] respectively! You can watch the panel live at 1 PM Pacific Time. 

Finally, we are very happy to discount the game again for the festival so more people can play it! Purchase during the festival and save up to 20%! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2302080/Death_of_a_Wish/

notes.title: The Randomizer Update is coming to Death of a Wish!
notes.content:
Hello all! [b]Death of a Wish[/b] has been out for over a month now, so we want to bring you some updates about what the future holds for this project. We have some really exciting news to share, so without further ado, let's get into it. 

[h2]Randomizer Update[/h2]
On Thursday, May 9, we're launching the [b]Randomizer Update[/b] for [b]Death of a Wish[/b], which, as the name implies, will add a new randomized game mode option that allows players to experience the game like never before. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44191615/94afb8ba2becb8ee52b120f05aa8857311c50019.png[/img]

Did you beat [b]Death of a Wish[/b] and find yourself still hungry for more? The Randomizer Update is for you! This mode allows players looking for an extra challenge, or those who just want another taste of [b]Death of a Wish[/b], to replay the entire game with randomized enemy and item placements, including randomized starting equipment. 

Take on the game in brand new ways by mastering different combat styles and managing unpredictable encounters thanks to new item and weapon placements. Nothing will be the same as your first time through, so it's almost like trying the game from scratch!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44191615/e67a27c1c41db29ecc10d24f18d3b58ca868a8c4.png[/img]

For those who want to crank the difficulty up even more, this update also includes a "True Randomizer" mode that makes it possible for players to encounter mini-bosses and regular bosses as regular enemies in the world. 

[h2]LudoNarraCon[/h2]
We're so excited to let you all know that [b]Death of a Wish[/b] is an official selection for this year's Ludonarracon event on Steam! The digital festival runs from May 9 - 13, kicking off at 10 a.m. Pacific Time on the 9th. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44191615/03fb6971db92ccf4752022399f567fb30591fe04.jpg[/img]

During this event Colin will be showing off the Randomizer Update in action via a livestream on [b]May 9 at 11 AM PST.[/b]

Colin and Kevin are also hosting a panel on [b]Meaningful Combat Design in Narrative Games[/b] during the event, though the date and time for that are still TBD. We will let you all know those details as soon as we have them. 

[h2]Mac & Linux port[/h2]
Alongside the Randomizer Update, we're also [b]launching Mac and Linux versions of Death of a Wish on May 9[/b]. As of that date, the game will officially be available on PC, Mac, Linux, and Nintendo Switch. 

As always, if you haven't yet please leave a review for Death of a Wish! Thank you all for your time and support!

melessthanthree

notes.title: Patch Notes v1.0.7
notes.content:
Hello all!

[i]Death of a Wish[/i] has now been out for three weeks, and it's been wild seeing the game grow and reach new audiences. We've also gotten a ton of great feedback from our reviews, comments, and watching people stream/let's play, and this latest update focuses mostly on addressing these notes. Here's a quick rundown of the biggest changes:

[b]Features[/b]
[list]
[*]Added a new setting in the options menu called [b]Combat Contrast[/b]. When this setting is on, the game will further contrast the player/enemy characters from the background, as well as reduce background visual noise during combat. There are four settings with this option, each with a more exaggerated effect: [b]Off, On, Extra, and Max[/b]. If you're having trouble distinguishing enemy movement from the background, give one of these increased settings a try!
[*]Chris can now [b]Rewind out of hitstun[/b]. You can even cancel the big knockback hitstun with a Rewind use! We hope this will encourage players to experiment with using the Rewind, and prevent frustration caused by taking a lethal hit right as you're trying to input a Rewind.
[*]Altered the [b]sound cue[/b] when an enemy starts an [b]unparryable[/b] attack, to better distinguish the sound from the parryable attack.
[/list]
[b]Balances[/b]
[list]
[*]Enemies will now be less likely to [b]overlap[/b] their attacks patterns when fighting in groups, particularly on the [b]Easy and Normal SIN difficulties[/b]. [i]This change is intentionally lessened on the harder SIN difficulties, but still has some effect compared to previous versions.[/i]
[*]Altered the timing on the visual enemy attack cue so that it more closely signals the beginning of the parry/perfect dodge timing.
[*]Chris no longer loses his brief period of invincibility from parrying when immediately cancelling the parry animation into a counterattack. The grace period for a successful parry should now last about one second from the moment the parry was triggered, regardless of whether the animation gets cancelled or not.
[*]Further tweaked the health values and damage type weakness/resistances of various boss encounters (including [i]Crusade Engine Uriel[/i]).
[/list]
[b]Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug that caused certain parryable enemy attacks to be marked as unparryable.
[/list]
If you haven't started the game yet or were waiting for some concerns to be addressed, this is a great time to play and leave a review! [i]Death of a Wish[/i] has already garnered 60+ positive reviews at the time of writing, and it'd be so cool to see the game get to 100 Steam reviews! With your help, I think we can do it.

Thanks again and talk soon,
- Colin

notes.title: Death of a Wish - Updates 3/20/24
notes.content:
Hello all!

There's just a few small hotfixes that I wanted to highlight that have made it into the build since Monday:

[list]
[*]Fixed an out of bounds/possible sequence break in the "City Ruins" area.
[*]Increased the PIERCE afflict of RAPID's projectiles.
[*][Track 2] Adjusted aspects of the Crusader Engine Uriel boss fight that might help those who are struggling with it.
[*]More work has been done to help distinguish enemy attack signals and tells, and reduce audio/visual clutter when fighting alongside a companion.

notes.title: Death of a Wish - Week 1 Update
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

As we reach the one week point since Death of a Wish's release, I want to thank everyone again for playing, sharing, and reviewing the game! We're at [b]35[/b] Steam reviews at the time of writing, which is so exciting to see. If you got a chance to play the game this weekend, please take a minute to leave a review; it would be so cool to get to the 50 [b]"Very Positive"[/b] review threshold soon!

There have been a few hotfixes and tweaks to make it into the build since I last updated, here's a quick rundown!

Features:
[list]
[*]Added two new tech options: "[b]Teleport UI[/b]" and "[b]Disconnect[/b]". The Teleport UI tech lets you toggle the Teleport indicators and arrows on/off, while the Disconnect tech lets you toggle the Disconnect ability on/off once it's been unlocked [i](the ability will still be active when required for progression, even when the tech is toggled off)[/i].
[*]Tweaked the enemy attack signal audio and visuals to be more prominent on the screen/in the sound mix.
[*]Thickened Chris's outline and shadow during combat to help with visibility and positioning.
[*]Added a new type of Damage Number to show when damage has been [b]boosted [/b]due to an enemy being [b]TAUNTed[/b].
[*]When in combat, you now need to [b]run into the scene transition[/b] boundaries for a brief time to trigger the scene transition. It takes a little less than half a second, with the hope that this should [b]prevent unintentional scene changes during combat[/b]. A UI indicator will show how long until the transition triggers. Scene transitions should behave as before when not in combat. [i]I've seen more than a few players voice frustrations with this, so please leave a comment if this helps![/i]
[/list]

Balance:
[list]
[*]Decreased the Track 1 Boss S-rank requirement, but made its time bonus requirement slightly stricter.
[*][Post-Track 5 spoilers] Made it a little harder for the player character to get stuck on enemy colliders during the "[b]RUN[/b]" encounter.
[/list]

Fixes:
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug that would allow Corruption to rise on death when the Corruption meter is not active.
[*] [Post-Track 5 spoilers] Fixed a wrong warp when going into the radio tower elevator, then immediately leaving the elevator.
[/list]

Thank you all again! The whole team hopes you've enjoyed and continue to enjoy Death of a Wish.

- Colin

notes.title: Death of a Wish - Patch v1.0.5
notes.content:
Hello all!

This is Colin again, and I want to thank you all for the great launch week we've been having so far! It's been so rewarding seeing all your reviews and playthroughs, and I hope you all continue to enjoy Death of a Wish! 

Just a reminder, if you've been playing and enjoying Death of a Wish, don't forget to leave a review! It'll help with our visibility so more potential fans can find and enjoy the game, which will help our community grow. It only takes a minute but makes a big impact!

With that out of the way, here's some update notes for the just-launched patch v1.0.5:

[b]Features[/b]
[list]
[*]The [b]Screenshake[/b] option has been slightly reworked to better address concerns some players expressed about disorientation/motion sickness. Additionally, a new intensity level has been added called "Reduced", so the options are now (from greatest to lowest intensity) [b]On > Reduced > Low > Off[/b]. If you are someone who was concerned with the intensity of camera movement in this game, let me know if this helps!
[*]The game now has its own [b]mouse cursor[/b]! This was actually supposed to be in the launch version of the game, but there was an error with the image file. If you prefer or have gotten used to just having the default mouse cursor when playing with keyboard + mouse, leave a comment and I'll take it into consideration.
[/list]
[b]Balances[/b]
[list]
[*]Reworked Sol's Hold Action's damage stat scaling. This rework should make it more viable to use in melee-focused builds, which better fits its design intention.
[*]Slightly reworked the S-rank thresholds for a few early-game enemies.
[/list]
[b]Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a softlock in the underground Subway area that would trigger when fighting a specific encounter in New Game+.
[*] Fixed a bug caused by skipping a cutscene in Track 4 that opened the door to the Track's dungeon area. Skipping that cutscene should now still open the door as intended without having to leave and re-enter the room.
[*] Fixed a bug that made the [b]Scorned[/b] Virtue look like it was [i]increasing[/i] your stats instead of [b][i]decreasing[/i][/b] them as intended. This was only a visual bug, but the stats in the Level Up screen should now match Chris's intended stats when Scorned  is equipped.
[*] Fixed a softlock that occurred at the end of Track 4/start of Track 5 if you started the game with an old demo save file (pre-February 2024 Next Fest demo version). [i]If your save file is affected, you might see an item in your inventory that you don't remember picking up. When you get to the point where you are supposed to pick up that item, the scene where Chris picks it up will automatically play, and your inventory will be unaffected.[/i]
[*][b][Track 2 Boss Spoilers][/b] Asking for help from Naomi during the [b]Crusade Engine Uriel[/b] fight no longer locks you in to summoning her for every subsequent attempt.
[*][b][Track 4 Minor Spoilers][/b] Rewinding during the timed combat sequence now [b]resets the countdown timer[/b] to whatever time it was at the start of the current combat round.
[*][b][Track 5+ Sidequest Spoilers][/b] Fixed a bug that prevented the final merchant cutscene from playing in New Game+ if you fulfilled his sidequest conditions on a previous new game cycle. [i]If you run into this, you still need to [b]talk to the merchant[/b] before the scene will trigger, but as long as you have his final item in your inventory, the scene will play as expected when you walk away from him.[/i]
[*][b][Track 5+ Sidequest Spoilers][/b] Fixed a softlock that would trigger when attempting to save Will from the Neo-Sanctum knights after previously failing the fight.
[/list]

That's all for now! On behalf of the entire Death of a Wish team, thank you for all of your support, and we hope you continue to enjoy Death of a Wish!
- Colin

notes.title: Death of a Wish - Day 1 Patch
notes.content:
Hello all!

This is Colin, the lead developer of Death of a Wish. I want to thank everyone who's made this game launch so excellent, especially those of you who took the time to leave a Steam review. It's been amazing seeing this game finally out in the world, with everyone's unique playstyles and story theories emerging. Thank you again!

I'll be continuing to watch as more people play the game and make some notes on balancing or other tweaks accordingly, but in the meantime I've put out a small update to address some immediate things I've noticed. Here's a quick rundown of the most pertinent changes:

Bugs:
- Fixed an issue in Track 3 where dying after resting at a certain checkpoint would cause two different background soundtracks to overlap.
- Fixed a background music sound file that plays in Track 4 that did not export properly; it should now sound as intended.
- Removed the ability for the Key Item Display UI to display during a certain end game scene.

Balances:
- Made the threshold for going from a C to a B rank in combat a little more generous.
- To a lesser extent, made rank thresholds less strict all around (Normal Sin difficulty and lower only).
- Reduced the S rank score requirement for a few miniboss-level enemies.
- Slightly increased the amount of Corruption reduction granted by lower combat ranks.
- Increased the damage bonus Hold Actions receive when hitting an enemy in the BREAK state.
- Slightly increased the health and revenge values of certain boss encounters, especially in the mid-game.
- Slightly reduced the burst damage granted by the SCORCH and FREEZE status affliction.
- Slightly reduced the bonus to status affliction and potency provided by the INFECTIOUS virtue.

Thank you again for all your support; the team and I hope you continue to enjoy Death of a Wish!

- Colin

notes.title: 'DEATH OF A WISH' IS NOW AVAILABLE
notes.content:
[b]Death of a Wish [/b]is available [b]right now[/b]! Check out the new launch trailer and fight your way through a nightmare world on Steam today!

[previewyoutube=tleiqAL6PiI;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]THE NEO-SANCTUM SHALL FALL.[/b] Claim retribution against the theocratic Faiths as you master vicious hack-and-slash combat in Death of a Wish, a vicious action-RPG where style is salvation.

Play as Christian as he unites with others to challenge the oppressive religious order that raised him. By taking down the four Sanctum Faiths: Father, Sister, Cardinal, and Priest, they will upend the order of the world.

"Death of a Wish is a game made with a lot of passion and righteous fury, inspired by both games we love and struggles we face in the world today, and we hope that fire comes through in a thrilling play experience.” - Colin Horgan, Death of a Wish Creator

[h2]Features:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Challenging, rewarding combat that emphasizes tactical aggression -- achieve high style ranks to reduce ever-escalating corruption
[*] A robust RPG system with powerful perks that allow you to alter the rhythm of combat to fit  your playstyle
[*] Explore a bleak dreamworld where traumas come to life as surreal characters, encounters, and stories
[*] A chilling soundtrack that blends electronics and live instruments by Nicolo Telesca
[/list]

notes.title: Death of a Wish is coming to the Steam Next Fest!
notes.content:
[b]Death of a Wish[/b] is coming to the [b]Steam Next Festival[/b] with an revised and expanded free demo! 

This demo contains the game’s first two chapters, about 90 minutes of content. In it, Christian’s quest to defeat the Four Faiths brings him to the frozen forest of Lethean, where he will meet new allies and enemies in dark new encounters. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44191615/9715527a44ef2648a3b5bfe419d80068f329345d.png[/img]

Throughout the [b]Steam Next Festival,[/b] you can participate in a special challenge where you can [b]win a postcard from the developers[/b] by exhibiting [b]exceptional performance in battle.[/b] Read on to learn how! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44191615/069cfa10ad40592f46e8a95a773bf16eab262dae.png[/img]

Players who can [b]complete Madeline's Trainer Challenges in Track 1[/b] and submit proof will receive an exclusive postcard featuring [b][url=https://brianna-lei.itch.io]Brianna Lei[/url]’s ethereal key art[/b] and a [b]personalized message from the developers. [/b]

This is an opportunity to get some cool physical [i]Death of a Wish[/i] collectibles that shouldn’t be missed. In order to participate, please follow these instructions. 

[olist]
[*] Download and install the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2302080/Death_of_a_Wish/]Death of a Wish Demo[/url]. 
[*] Progress to "Track 1 - Extraneo"
[*] Reach the encounter with the character "Madeline" 
[*] Complete all four of her challenges, including the fourth challenge, "Unmatched"
[*] Take a screenshot using F12 indicating that you have successfully completed "Unmatched". See examples of [url=https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Q37SA2Sj3Hd3TDkP3Pt3pP7vML9SIksa]acceptable scenes here[/url]. 
[*] Submit the screenshot in [url=https://forms.gle/hszgBUmVCJ6hQrFY8]this Google Form[/url]. 
[/olist]

The contest will run from [b]02/05/24 to 02/12/24[/b]. Due to postage costs, we can send prizes to addresses in the United States only. 

We will take care to protect the privacy of your data. Your personal information will be used only to send you the prize if you choose to participate in this event. 

Submit your scores [url=https://forms.gle/hszgBUmVCJ6hQrFY8]here![/url]

[h2]Death of a Wish Descends on 03/11/24[/h2]

In case you missed it, we are also thrilled to announce that Death of a Wish is releasing on [b]March 11th, 2024[/b]! Check out the new story trailer by [url=https://www.youtube.com/@CodexEntry/featured]CodexEntry[/url].

[previewyoutube=AZVI6F7MogM;full][/previewyoutube]

If you enjoyed the [i]Death of a Wish[/i] demo, don’t forget to wishlist and follow it so you can get all the latest news and updates once it releases on [b]March 11th[/b]! 

[h2]Warnings[/h2]

The [b]Death of a Wish[/b] demo contains intense animated violence, flashing lights, and stylized blood and gore. There is some mild language, as well as implied child abuse and religious abuse. Religious symbolism appears throughout.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2302080/Death_of_a_Wish/
